text: 1. Valid ordinary passport photo page (valid until September 1, 2026 and beyond) 2. Highest academic degree diploma and degree certificate. For fresh graduates, a projected graduation certificate should be issued by their respective schools. If admitted, they are required to provide scanned copies of their graduation certificate and degree certificate before registration. 3. Complete transcripts of all courses from the undergraduate stage. 4. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (HSK scores obtained from September 1, 2023 onwards are valid). 5. Letter of Acceptance from the Supervisor (if there is a submission requirement). 6. Two recommendation letters written by professors or associate professors, in either Chinese or English. The issuance time of the recommendation letter should be later than September 1, 2024 and should include the following information: the title of the recommender, the employer's name, contact number, email address, and the recommender's signature. 7. Study plan or research plan for coming to China (if applicable), no less than 800 words. 8. Other supporting application materials (such as published papers, award certificates, etc.). 9. Certificate of No Criminal Record. If the home country cannot issue a certificate of no criminal record, a commitment letter for no criminal record can be signed; if currently studying in China, a proof of no misconduct during the school period can be submitted. 10. Economic guarantee certificate. 11. Copy of the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form". The original should be kept by the applicant. This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese Health Quarantine Department and must be filled out in English. The applicant should conduct the examination strictly in accordance with the items required in the "Foreigner Physical Examination Form". A "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" with missing items, without a personal photo attached, without a seam seal on the photo, or without the signatures and stamps of a doctor and a hospital is invalid.
